messages.Title: HKSR Character Manager
messages.DeleteInstanceHelp: Remove this character from the current layout. Enable and rebuild cannot restore it. Previously saved snapshots are not changed.
messages.NpcSourceHelp: Uses the NPC's own model and actions. Battle actions cannot be combined with this NPC appearance.
messages.PlayerSourceHelp: Provides exploration and battle presentation. Switching domains loads the corresponding complete official model.
messages.ExternalHelp: Existing external-asset support. Authoring tools and further external-asset work are deferred.
messages.SelectSourceHint: Select a source on the left.
messages.WaitingScene: Waiting for an available exploration scene.
messages.StateMissing: The selected state is not in the current controller.
messages.NpcActionsHelp: Official NPC: uses this source's NPC actions, without battle presentation from another source.
messages.BattleModelHelp: Playing a battle action switches to this character's official battle model.
messages.BattleCategoryHelp: This category uses battle presentation and switches the complete model.
messages.ReactionScope: Body, expression and blink supported. Material, speed and floating effects are not implemented.
messages.ReadyHelp: Click to switch ready poses using available official transitions. Play a regular action to leave.
messages.ReadyTooltip: Uses official base skill settings, without damage, target selection, or battle conditions.
messages.ReadyAttackHelp: Each pose lists self-animation clips linked by its official entry ability. Multiple clips are explicit choices; combat conditions and damage are not executed.
messages.BodyFaceHelp: Body and expression from official settings, not gameplay statuses or numeric effects.
messages.RawStateHelp: Raw layer states are not complete actions. Facial and body layers can be independent.
messages.ConfiguredHelp: Candidates from official settings. Not every listed state is verified playable.
messages.NpcFoundationHelp: Motions from the NPC foundation. The player model may not support every entry.
messages.ControllerNotRead: This domain's controller has not been read. Play a configured action first, or clear the search.
messages.AxesHelp: World axes: Y is height. Click to step; hold to repeat.
messages.SnapGroundHelp: Snap to ground. Y+ / Y- turns ground snapping off.
messages.NpcPlacementHint: The game may control NPC position and facing, so adjustments may not take effect.
messages.RawDiagnostics: Raw logs and resource identifiers retain their original text.
messages.PlacementApplied: Position applied after the official movement update
messages.PlacementWaiting: Waiting for this instance's official movement update
messages.GazeSubmitted: Submitted to official gaze constraints and smoothing
messages.SettingsNotSaved: Language could not be saved. The current selection still works.
messages.LayoutHelp: Each map automatically keeps its current layout across travel and restarts. Named snapshots below are manual saves, separate from automatic persistence.
messages.LayoutUnavailable: Waiting for a current map and layout storage.
messages.LayoutPreparing: Preparing official sources and actions; the old layout is intact
messages.LayoutFailed: Layout operation failed; see the details
messages.LayoutLoadHelp: Loading replaces the current layout. Any layout you have not saved separately will be lost. Continue?
messages.LayoutOverwriteHelp: Overwrite the existing snapshot with this name.
messages.LayoutDeleteHelp: Delete this named snapshot without changing the current layout.
messages.LayoutKeepHelp: Abandon restoration of the existing automatic save and overwrite it with the current layout. An empty current layout is saved as empty.
